description: Fork of sorento-sub-respond-sendmsg-respond (aoydkG1dbItXR5jXFEQsP) with an additive, fail-safe chat_id gate: when contact.chat_id is present, replies are RPUSHed to redis chat:reply:{chat_id} for the chat console instead of respond.io. chat_id absent = o
name: sub-sendmsg-CHAT

parameters.messageData: ={{ JSON.stringify({ type: $json.type, text: $json.text, quick_reply: $json.quick_reply, part: $json.part, total_parts: $json.total_parts, ts: $json.ts }) }}

value.data:
={{ JSON.stringify(
  {
    "contact_id": `${$('When Executed by Another Workflow').first().json.contact_identifer}`,
  "phone_number": $('When Executed by Another Workflow').first().json.contact.phone,
  "message": $('Loop Over Items').item.json.message,
  "sent_at": new Date().getTime(),
  "first_name": $('When Executed by Another Workflow').first().json.contact.firstName,
  "last_name": $('When Executed by Another Workflow').first().json.contact.lastName,
  "type": "outgoing",
  "message_id": `${$('Send a Message').item.json.messageId}`,
  "result": $('Loop Over Items').item.json.result
}) }}

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ String($('When Executed by Another Workflow').first().json.contact_identifer), String(($('When Executed by Another Workflow').first().json.contact || {}).phone || '60100000000'), ($json.text || ''), (($('When Executed by Another Workflow').first().json.contact || {}).firstName || null), (($('When Executed by Another Workflow').first().json.contact || {}).lastName || null), JSON.stringify({ quick_reply: ($json.quick_reply ? String($json.quick_reply).split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean) : []), result_set: ($('When Executed by Another Workflow').first().json.result_set || []), type: $json.type, part: $json.part, source: 'chat-console' }) ] }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO chat_histories (id, channel, contact_id, phone_number, message, sent_at, first_name, last_name, type, created_at, message_id, result) SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id),0)+1, 'whatsapp', $1, $2, $3, NOW(), $4, $5, 'outgoing', NOW(), NULL, $6::jsonb FROM chat_histories;
